title: MOCHEG: Multimodal Fact-Checking with Explanations
description: Multimodal fact-checking requiring reasoning over both text and images. Annotators verify claims using multimodal evidence, identify relevant spans in text evidence, and provide explanations for their verdicts. Based on the MOCHEG dataset (Yao et al., SIGIR 2023).
